stage_tasks_completed_scope: B01-B04: bounded language snapshot/context renderer combinations for published-point/1 and published-interval/1; not general T28/M2 completion
enabled_scope: host/definition opt-in history plus matching current context_token, query and authority; frozen qualified locale-context/1 on published points or certified stable intervals; independent requested valid_at, current permission/erasure guards and explicit coverage gaps

proof.context: Immutable definition/generation/hash freezes principal, scope, routing attributes, timezone, snapshot token and ProjectionPolicy; point metadata attests context digest and knowledge lifetime without copying routing attributes.
proof.time: Requested known_at must lie inside the frozen context knowledge lifetime and published coverage. Requested valid_at is independent. Today's expiry blocks current processing but does not erase authorized old knowledge. Frozen routing is a query parameter, not evidence of past real-world routing facts.
proof.boundary: Interval end is the earlier of first semantic change and old context expiry. Later context changes or later checkpoints never extend old coverage.
proof.qualification: Frozen L1 row versions preserve conditions/exceptions, field AND/OR/point support, exact source spans/hashes, target hash and policy versions; old admission/projection policy is validated rather than borrowing today's interpretation.
proof.access: Current matching host route, authority/floor, past/current reader/purpose, all actual source grants and completion/erasure checks precede archived L1 and auxiliary evidence.
proof.erase: Shared object/scope deletion and real backup replay remove qualified archives, manifests, context certificates and interval proofs.
proof.backend: Reuse original SQLite/PostgreSQL UoW/scope locks, CAS, jobs and write-hooks/1. No DDL, extra queue, SDK/MCP write interface or mandatory dependencies.

tests.real_sigkill_matrix: qualified point/interval publication before/after commit × both backends (8); interval context rotation before/after commit × both backends (4); older fault/crash regressions also run
tests.accounting: Final targeted run only; no prior-stage scores or installed repeats counted.
tests.fixture_repair: Weekday test advances beyond a one-hour authority; use a bounded 24-hour test authority so frozen weekday semantics and live authority expiry are tested separately. The original expiry denial was correct.

installed.source: fresh core/PostgreSQL wheels in /tmp/agent-memory-stage14b3-installed; unchanged SDK/MCP from existing environment
installed.exclusion: 12 actual SIGKILL cases excluded from installed rerun because the source helper controls subprocess PYTHONPATH; all 12 passed on real source processes

build_note: Standard isolated sdist-to-wheel builds, hatchling 1.32.4; all production source and type markers match final tested code. PostgreSQL adapter, SDK and MCP production code is unchanged in this slice.
quality_evidence: Synthetic retained sources and protocol/fault fixtures; no production gold, external model or remote ACL quality claim.
